narrative: The technology sector is buzzing with developments in AI and infrastructure, as OpenAI shows strong growth in business AI adoption and Google offers new tools to help publishers navigate AI-driven content changes. Developers are also seeing significant updates, with Emacs 31.1 on the horizon and advancements in Linux MicroVMs on Apple Silicon, while environmental concerns are highlighted by Europe's scorching summer.

highlights.title: Emacs 31.1 will release on 8/24
highlights.whyItMatters: The upcoming release of Emacs 31.1 marks a significant update for the long-standing developer tool.

highlights.title: We Rebuilt the Linux MicroVM Stack on Apple Silicon
highlights.whyItMatters: This development enables Firecracker microVMs to run natively on Apple Silicon, enhancing developer environments.

highlights.title: Europe’s Scorching Summer
highlights.whyItMatters: Europe is experiencing record-breaking heatwaves, highlighting pressing climate change impacts.

highlights.title: AI companies destroy physical books – let's scan rare books before it's too late
highlights.whyItMatters: Concerns are rising over AI companies destroying physical books, prompting calls to digitize rare collections.

highlights.title: Tesla, Uber, and Waymo all get the OK to operate thousands of robotaxis in Nevada
highlights.whyItMatters: Nevada has approved large-scale robotaxi operations, signaling a major expansion of autonomous vehicle services.

highlights.title: OpenAI is gaining on Anthropic with business users, new data indicates
highlights.whyItMatters: New data suggests OpenAI is expanding its lead in the business AI market, intensifying competition with Anthropic.

highlights.title: The August 17 outage
highlights.whyItMatters: GitHub experienced a significant outage, prompting a detailed review of service reliability and recovery efforts.

highlights.title: Google gives publishers a new way to fight AI-driven traffic losses
highlights.whyItMatters: Google is introducing tools for publishers to maintain traffic amidst increasing AI-driven content consumption.
